<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="xQ_25ZEEVIB0qi9pHuL-"> <mxGraphModel dx="1229" dy="627" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1100" pageHeight="850" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "graph TD
 subgraph External Entities
 User[\"👤 External Entity: Employee\"]
 Admin[\"👤 External Entity: Facility Manager\"]
 EmailGW[\"⚙️ External Entity: Email Gateway\"]
 end

 subgraph System Processes
 P1[\"1.0 Authenticate & Manage Users\"]
 P2[\"2.0 Search Available Desks\"]
 P3[\"3.0 Process Workspace Reservation\"]
 P4[\"4.0 Process Check-in Verification\"]
 P5[\"5.0 Manage Floor Plans & Desks\"]
 end

 subgraph Data Stores
 D1[(\"D1: User Accounts Store\")]
 D2[(\"D2: Desk Inventory Store\")]
 D3[(\"D3: Booking Store\")]
 end

 %% User Auth Flows
 User -->|Credentials| P1
 P1 <-->|Read / Write Profile Data| D1
 P1 -->|Session Token| User

 %% Admin Management Flows
 Admin -->|Floor Plan & Desk Layouts| P5
 P5 <-->|Read / Write Layout Data| D2

 %% Search Flows
 User -->|Date, Time & Floor Params| P2
 P2 <-->|Query Availability| D2
 P2 -->|Filtered Desk List| User

 %% Booking Flows
 User -->|Selected Desk & Time Slot| P3
 P3 <-->|Read User Profile| D1
 P3 <-->|Check & Update Desk Status| D2
 P3 -->|Write Reservation Record| D3
 P3 -->|Trigger Pass Dispatch| EmailGW
 P3 -->|QR Pass Details| User

 %% Check-in Flows
 User -->|Scan QR Pass at Terminal| P4
 P4 <-->|Validate Pass & Window| D3
 P4 -->|Update Status to Checked-In| D3
 P4 -->|Access Confirmation| User",
 "config": null
